column1: # Chrome, through `just conformance`: how many lines a box a pixel either side of a line breaks into.
# Measured on Chrome Headless Shell 153.0.8010.12, the chromium Playwright pins here.
# Text is 20px Fixture, line-height 1.2; "paragraph" is "one two three four five six seven eight".
# A stated width is a block at `left`; `auto` is a flex row item as wide as its content.
# `width` and `height` are the box from `getBoundingClientRect`; `lines` counts the
# distinct line tops of a range over the text.

column8: control: narrower than its widest line, so a third line
the defect: a hair wider than its widest line, two lines
control: two lines however the box rounds
its own width, which a whole-pixel box rounds down
